title: Server patching
desc: Check for and apply OS package updates (apt, dnf, yum, apk). Reboots are never automatic.
upToDate: Your server is up to date.
checkFailed: The update check couldn't complete — a package repository may be unreachable or misconfigured. This is not the same as being up to date.
unsupported: Automatic patching needs one of apt, dnf, yum or apk on the server.
rebootRequired: A reboot is required to finish applying updates.
agentDesc: Update the Tugra agent to the latest signed release. The hub picks a digest-pinned image from its verified release manifest; the agent reconnects on the new version.
agentConfirm: Update the Tugra agent on this server? It restarts on the new signed version and reconnects automatically.
agentSent: Update dispatched — the agent reconnects on the new version shortly.
agentOffline: The agent is offline — try again once it reconnects.
agentNoDigest: No signed image is available for this server's architecture.
agentCapability: The deploy capability isn't granted to this server's agent.
agentNotPermitted: You don't have permission to update this server's agent.
agentUnconfigured: Agent updates aren't configured on this hub (no signed release manifest).
agentError: Couldn't verify the latest signed release.
runtimeRestart: This update includes the container engine ({packages}). Applying it restarts Docker, so every app and database on this server restarts and is briefly unavailable.
agentRestartingHint: The agent is restarting on the new version. This card updates when it reconnects.
applyFailed: The update did not finish cleanly — see the log below.
rebootRequiredToast: Updates applied — a reboot is required to finish them.
appliedCounts: {updated} package(s) updated — the server is up to date.
appliedNothingLeft: The update finished — the server is up to date.
appliedNone: No packages were updated — {remaining} still pending. They may be held back or need new dependencies.
failedCounts: The update did not finish cleanly — {updated} package(s) updated, {remaining} still pending. See the log below.
restartedDone: {updated} package(s) updated. The agent restarted during the update and is back online — the server is up to date.
restartedPartial: The agent restarted during the update and is back online — {updated} package(s) updated, {remaining} still pending.
waitingAgent: The update restarted Docker, so the agent is reconnecting. Waiting for it, then checking for updates again…
rechecking: Update finished — checking what is left…
recheckFailed: Couldn't re-check the server after the update. The list below is hidden because it may be out of date — press “Check for updates”.
recheckFailedToast: The update ran, but the server could not be re-checked. Check for updates to see what changed.
interrupted: A previous update was interrupted: {packages} did not finish configuring. Checking never repairs this — it only reports it.
interruptedEngine: That includes the container engine. Finishing it restarts Docker, so every app and database on this server restarts and is briefly unavailable. “Update all (restarts apps)” (or updating any one package) completes it first, on the host, so the Docker restart cannot interrupt it.
interruptedRemedy: “Update all” (or updating any one package) completes the configuration first, on the host.
interruptedConfirm: dpkg is half-configured for {packages}. Continuing completes it first, and that restarts Docker — every app and database on this server restarts and is briefly unavailable. Continue?
stillRunning: An update is still running on this server. Waiting for it to finish, then checking again…
runningBanner: An update is running on this server right now — the list below may change. Check again when it finishes.
phasedDesc: Ubuntu is rolling this update out gradually; it installs automatically when this server's turn comes.
appliedPhased: Nothing was installed — {phased} package(s) deferred by Ubuntu's phased rollout. They install automatically when this server's turn comes, or use Install now.
appliedPhasedSome: {updated} package(s) updated; {phased} deferred by Ubuntu's phased rollout — they install automatically when this server's turn comes.
updateKeepHint: Installs everything except the container engine, so Docker and your apps keep running.
updateAllRestartHint: Also updates the container engine. Docker restarts, and every app and database on this server restarts with it.
updateAllNoEngineHint: The container engine is not part of this update, so your apps keep running.
updateAllConfirmTitle: Update everything, including the container engine?
updateAllConfirm: This installs {packages} too. Docker restarts, so every app and database on this server restarts and is briefly unavailable. To avoid that, use “Update (keep apps running)”.
keepBlockedInterrupted: A previous update left the container engine half-configured. Finishing it restarts Docker, so only “Update all (restarts apps)” can do it.
groupEngineHint: Updating these can restart Docker, and every app and database with it.
groupKernelHint: A new kernel only takes effect after a reboot. Installing it never reboots the server.
appliedKeepEngine: {updated} package(s) updated. {remaining} container engine package(s) were left alone so your apps kept running.
